sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: A Stance is an established martial posture, rhythm, guard, or fighting commitment. The granting card defines the Stance's actual benefit; the Condition itself adds no unstated universal bonus.

sections.label: REPLACEMENT
sections.html: You may maintain one Stance at a time. Assuming a new Stance ends the previous one.

sections.label: DURATION
sections.html: A Stance lasts until replaced, voluntarily ended during your Turn, removed by an explicit effect, or the Encounter ends. Losing Combo does not automatically end Stance unless that Stance says otherwise.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
